text:
sophie: Hey team — prepping Atlasica QBR (Mon 10am). Need spend sensitivity + ask list. Three scenarios: conservative (-30% usage), expected, growth (+50%). Can we get 30d token burn, top routes, and any upcoming embed-heavy campaigns? Also want credit cushion and auto-throttle settings. @ranjit

ranjit: On it. Pulling 30d numbers now. quick Q: want token burn split per route (api vs embed) or per-model?

sophie: per-route first (chat vs embed), model split helpful if available. Thanks.

drew: I can pull model split. Atlasica has a big embedding job that ran last week — likely skewing numbers.

maria: FYI renewals team flagged Atlasica as "green" but with a potential finance question if spend spikes. I'll draft the "ask" email once we have cushion number. :pencil2:

costbot: Billing report ready: https://internal/reports/atlasica-30d (access: redwood/cs). Summary: total tokens=4,250,000; est cost=$2,125 @ $0.0005/token. Embeddings=2,100,000 tokens (~49%); chat completions=2,150,000 tokens (~51%). Top route: /v1/embeddings/bulk (72% of embedding cost). See snippet:
```text
total_tokens: 4250000
embeddings: 2100000
completions: 2150000
est_cost_usd: 2125
```

ranjit: Good. For scenarios:
- conservative: -30% = 2,975,000 tokens (~$1,488)
- expected: baseline
- growth +50% = 6,375,000 tokens (~$3,188)
I'll update spreadsheet and add per-route rows. Linking: https://sheets.internal/atlasica-qbr

sophie: Perfect. Also, can we check if they have an active caching layer for embeddings? If we can recommend a prefix cache it might shave 20-30% off heavy reruns.

drew: They do not have prefix cache enabled on embeddings. I can add a quick guide and estimate impact. ETA EOD.

maria: For the "ask" — suggest: 1) confirm buffer credits of $3,000 for next quarter OR commit to 10% increase on reserved capacity, 2) enable embedding cache, 3) stagger bulk jobs. I'll draft copy.

ranjit: One more operational note — autoscale burst is currently off for Dedicated. If they expect growth, toggling burst + setting quota alerts is low lift.

sophie: Great. Two action items: @drew produce cache impact + model-split slides, @ranjit fill scenarios and cushion row in spreadsheet, @maria draft ask email + renewal note. I'll consolidate into a 2-slide QBR appendix. Thanks all. :rocket:

drew: ack. uploading a short chart and a 2-line playbook in #docs after done.

costbot: Alert created: budget-threshold atlasica set at $2,800 with slack notify to #cs and #finance. :white_check_mark:

maria: Filing the renewal blue-sheet with ask + cushion. Sending to sales tomorrow AM.

sophie: Closing loop — if anyone finds a different embed job (cron or lambda) please flag here. otherwise I'll assemble slides Sat.
